thread:
jess: Quick follow-up from the RDI-4021 postmortem: we promised concrete test artifacts and a small chaos checklist. Who can own what?
owen: I can take the regression suite authoring. Plan: two small suites `regression/stop_seq_sanity.json` and `regression/fallback_role_tokenization.json`. Aim for CI-friendly runs (~20s).
jess: Thanks. We also need a short canary gate in the deploy pipeline that runs the fallback prompt group.
tariq: I'll own the chaos checklist + scheduled dry-run. Proposed chaos steps: 1) warm KV cache, 2) baseline steady load 200 rps for 90s, 3) spike to 800 rps for 45-60s, 4) drain 1-2 GPUs mid-spike, 5) verify no stop-seq truncations and token-distribution shifts <5%.
anya: For the eval harness I will add: KV warmup step, a top-k token distribution metric, and an abort-on-regression flag that prevents canary promotion. Also add a CI badge that fails on any regression.
owen: Example minimal regression JSON (will live under suites/regression):
```json
[{"id":"stopseq-001","prompt":"user: long list
assistant:","assert":"complete_sequence"},
 {"id":"fallback-001","prompt":"role: user
content: ... (rep low-level tokenization)
assistant:","assert":"token_role_consistency"}]
```
jess: Good. Deadlines? Suggest: owen -> suites in 4 business days, anya -> eval harness + badge in 6 business days, tariq -> chaos dry-run in 10 business days. Owners + dates added to postmortem follow-ups.
tariq: I'll also add k6 snippet to the chaos-run ticket and schedule a run with SRE present. k6 spike snippet: ```js
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function(){
  http.post(__ENV.GEN_URL, JSON.stringify({prompt:'role:user\\ncontent: test'}), {headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}})
}
```
anya: Alerting: add a dashboard alert when top-k token distribution shift >5% over a 1h window and when stop-seq failures >0.5% in regression runs. Also add a short playbook for manual triage steps (collect prompts, KV state, model variant).
owen: Rotation: propose eng-ml weekdays 09:00-18:00, eng-sre nights/weekends. I'll write a one-pager rota and attach to the postmortem follow-ups.
incident-bot: Created task RDI-4301 (regression suites: stop-seq + fallback prompts) assigned to owen, due 2026-04-06.
incident-bot: Created task RDI-4302 (chaos checklist + dry-run) assigned to tariq, due 2026-04-12.
jess: Recap owners/dates: owen - regression suites (2026-04-06), anya - eval harness + CI gate (2026-04-08), tariq - chaos checklist & dry-run (2026-04-12), jess - update postmortem follow-ups and link tickets (2026-04-05). I'll update RDI-4021 with links and mark follow-ups as actionable. If anything slips, comment in the ticket and @jess so we can escalate. :white_check_mark:
